H1.question: Do people spend a found break on more fun than a planned break?
H1.account: A found break goes to more fun than a planned break: the found-time effect of Chung and colleagues, in the pooled sample of 12 countries.

H2.question: Do people give AI-saved time to paid work more, or less, than found time?
H2.account: AI-saved and found time go to paid work alike, within the bound, as the windfall account predicts.

H3.question: Do people spend AI-saved time on fun like a planned break?
H3.account: AI-saved time goes to more fun than planned time, as the windfall account predicts; H5 shows whether it goes to as much fun as found time.

H4.question: Does labeling the saving change the share of fun videos, and in which direction?
H4.account: The label does not change the share of fun, within the bound.

H5.question: Do people spend AI-saved time on less fun than found time?
H5.account: The windfall account: AI-saved time goes to fun like found time, within the bound.

pair_h3_h5.account: AI-saved time goes to more fun than planned time and to fun like found time, as the windfall account predicts.

h2_among_participants_who_stayed.label: a comparison of groups selected after assignment
